scripts.test:audit: npm audit --json | node -e 'const ignored = ["GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm"]; const report = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); if (report.error) { console.error(report.error.summary); process.exit(1); } const advisories = Object.values(report.vulnerabilities).flatMap((vulnerability) => vulnerability.via).filter((via) => typeof via === "object"); const isIgnored = (advisory) => ignored.some((id) => advisory.url.endsWith(id)); const open = advisories.filter((advisory) => !isIgnored(advisory)); const stale = ignored.filter((id) => !advisories.some((advisory) => advisory.url.endsWith(id))); advisories.filter(isIgnored).forEach((advisory) => console.warn(`ignored, no patched version: ${advisory.name} ${advisory.url}`)); open.forEach((advisory) => console.error(`${advisory.severity}: ${advisory.name}: ${advisory.title} ${advisory.url}`)); stale.forEach((id) => console.error(`${id} is no longer reported, remove it from the ignore list in test:audit`)); process.exit(open.length + stale.length > 0 ? 1 : 0);'
